caption: Reggia di Caserta, Caserta
composition: Vast Bourbon royal palace facade with central pediment and empty monumental forecourt · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint is from the middle of the vast empty forecourt, facing the Reggia di Caserta head-on. The endless symmetrical facade stretches the full width of the frame, the columned central portico and its carved pediment at the center, row upon row of windows running to both wings. The modelled 23 September 2026, 11:10 morning is pale and bright, the high sun washing the pale stone almost white against a thin blue sky.
